title: NFTMinterV2._executeMint lacks ReentrancyGuard (cross-index re-entry not blocked)
description: The dispatch() nonReentrant guard lives on the dispatcher (ATokenDispatcherV2.sol:118-126), so re-entry into NFTMinterV2._executeMint (lines 170-201) targeting a DIFFERENT dispatcher index is not blocked by a guard on NFTMinterV2 itself. No current in-scope dispatcher makes a re-entrant external call, so it is not exploitable today.
impact: None today. No in-scope path is exploitable: in-scope hooks make no external calls in onDispatch, and BalancerPoolerV2._dispatch only forceApprove + ERC4626.deposit. A re-entrant mint would be a fully-paid mint. This is a latent defense-in-depth gap.
attackPath: Latent: dispatch() nonReentrant guard lives on the dispatcher (ATokenDispatcherV2.sol:118-126), so re-entry into _executeMint targeting a DIFFERENT dispatcher index is not blocked by a guard on NFTMinterV2 itself (170-201). No current in-scope dispatcher makes a re-entrant external call, so it is not exploitable today.
assumptions: Would require a future/added dispatcher whose onDispatch makes a re-entrant external call.
externalRequirements: A re-entrancy-capable dispatcher that does not currently exist in scope.
recommendation: Add a ReentrancyGuard / nonReentrant modifier to NFTMinterV2._executeMint (or the public entrypoints that reach it) so cross-index re-entry is blocked at the minter level regardless of which dispatcher is added in future.
justification: Missing guard is a real, present property of in-scope code (concrete root cause and concrete fix) but no current in-scope path makes it exploitable. Defense-in-depth hardening -> Low.
